We initially came here just to check the prices, as we had already compared several clinics in Chiang Mai, including those located in shopping malls. From the very first moment, the experience was completely different. Two ladies immediately came out to welcome me and my wife, greeted us warmly, and took the time to talk with us instead of trying to sell anything.
The atmosphere was calm, friendly, and very comfortable — no crowds, no noise, no pressure, and no people pushing flyers into your hands like in shopping malls. The clinic itself is very modern, clean, and clearly well maintained, with a professional and sterile environment, but still warm and pleasant inside.
Although the prices listed online were promotional, the staff kindly honored the holiday promotional prices for us without any hesitation. Thanks to this, we were able to get a treatment package for nearly half the price compared to similar clinics in shopping malls, where prices were literally twice as high. Everything was clearly explained and calculated in advance, so there were no surprises at all.
We were taken in immediately, without waiting, and the laser hair removal treatment was completely painless. Every step of the procedure was explained carefully, and the staff made sure we felt comfortable throughout the entire process. Communication in English was very good — everything was easy to understand and there were no issues at all.
During our visit, we also learned that the clinic offers Botox treatments not only for the jaw and forehead, but also for other areas of the body. They also provide facial fillers to reduce wrinkles and restore volume where needed, as well as CO₂ skin boosters and vitamin IV drips. We are definitely interested in trying more treatments here in the future. Since these procedures usually require follow-up sessions, we are certain we will be coming back.
In terms of price, quality of service, professionalism, friendly staff, and central location, this is by far the best clinic we have found in Chiang Mai. We highly recommend this place to anyone traveling or living here.

I had a really disappointing experience at this clinic. I came in for Botox expecting professional care, but the results left one of my eyebrows drooping and made my eyes look uneven and heavy. It completely changed the look of my face and made me feel self-conscious and uncomfortable.

When I told the clinic what happened, they kept offering free follow-up treatments instead of acknowledging the mistake or offering a refund. But after what happened, I honestly don’t feel comfortable letting them do anything else to my face. I asked for a refund multiple times and was met with vague explanations about company policy and how they “can fix it” — but it feels like they just want to keep me coming back so they don’t have to take responsibility.

As a foreigner, I also felt like I didn’t have any protection or support. This whole experience made me really anxious, and I wouldn’t want anyone else to go through the same thing.

Please be careful and ask lots of questions before committing to anything here.
